scripts.sync: npm run stop-dev && docker compose -f backend/compose.yaml up -d postgres redis mailpit minio minio-init && npm --prefix frontend ci && docker compose -f backend/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm --build backend-migrate sh -lc "npm run db:generate && npm run db:validate && npm run db:migrate:deploy"
scripts.db:reset:docker: docker compose -f backend/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm --build backend-reset
scripts.db:seed:docker: docker compose -f backend/compose.yaml --profile tools run --rm --build backend-migrate sh -lc "npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed"
